text: Peverell Semiconductors cut 310 jobs in a restructuring announced Tuesday, according to a company filing with the Arundel Commerce Registry and a memo from chief executive Mira Talbot to employees. The layoffs, spread across manufacturing and design teams, amount to roughly 12 percent of the firm’s workforce, the filing said. Talbot wrote that the company was “aligning capacity with a softer order book” after two quarters of declining sales in its precision sensor division. The memo said affected staff would receive severance, outplacement support and health coverage through the end of September. Peverell’s headquarters in North Wexley will remain open, but two satellite engineering offices are to be consolidated by year-end, the filing added.
